name: Bupropion
description: Antidepressant of the aminoketone class; for weight, approved only combined with naltrexone

note.text: For weight, FDA approved bupropion only combined with naltrexone, as Contrave (2014).

bullets: **Label:** mechanism unknown; presumed noradrenergic and/or dopaminergic
**Relatively weak** blocker of noradrenaline and dopamine reuptake
**Does not** block serotonin reuptake or inhibit monoamine oxidase
**With naltrexone,** lab and animal data point to appetite and reward areas
Alone for weight: RCTs of 327 and 384 adults

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak about 5 hours (XL); liver metabolism, mainly CYP2B6
practical.monitored: Mood and suicidal thoughts, blood pressure

regulatory.text: Approved: depression, smoking; weight via Contrave

references: FDA, Wellbutrin XL prescribing information, Feb 2026
